candidate_evidence.quote: Carboplatin infusion on the day of Exablate BBBD procedure to treat cancerous cells in the brain

candidate_flag.reason: Primary question is the device (focused ultrasound BBB opening); carboplatin is the only antitumour drug and is not an established GBM therapy per D6.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Tumor progression after first line therapy

role_evidence.quote: Carboplatin will be administered via IV infusion about every 4 weeks for up to 6 cycles.

Known sensitivity or contraindications to ultrasound contrast agent or perflutren

agents.drug_class_hint: ultrasound contrast microbubbles used to open the blood-brain barrier

flag.reason: Microbubbles are not a registered intervention and the specific product is inferred from the exclusion criterion; they are delivery-enabling, not antitumour.

coder_notes: Device (Exablate focused ultrasound) trial to open the BBB for carboplatin. Device itself not listed as an agent. Adjudicator to decide whether carboplatin counts as a candidate or the trial is device-driven.
